free_tier.stated: Allocation requests for Neocortex are accepted by the NSF ACCESS program on a rolling basis; eligibility criteria to use this resource free of charge are as follows: projects must be non-proprietary; applicants must be a researcher or educator at a US academic or non-profit research institution; a principal investigator (PI) is required, PIs may not be a high school, undergraduate or graduate student, a qualified advisor must serve in this capacity, and postdocs are eligible to serve as PI.

chaining: The allocation is the only route to a CS-3 that does not involve a purchase, and it chains with publishing the result. It breaks at the PI requirement, which no amount of preparation substitutes for.

limits.value: a PI at a US academic or non-profit institution plus a reviewed ACCESS allocation request, so identity fails before any quota does.
